title: Ordinary scalar extension comparison on an open component
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme T and an open subscheme U with the normalized coefficient restriction datum d [def-sf-clopen-restriction-data]. For every positive exponent n+1, restriction of ordinary extension of scalars is naturally isomorphic to ordinary extension of scalars after completed-coefficient restriction [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The isomorphism sends the sheafified tensor d.finite(s) tensor x to s tensor x for every local object, coefficient and section [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. This is only an ordinary module statement: no derived categories or chain quotient comparisons are assumed.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized comparison with raw restricted coefficients from lem-sf-clopen-scalar-raw-restriction-comparison. This is the cocontinuous sheafification step, separated to compile its generic tensor argument once.

Lift d.completion and d.finite to commutative-ring sheaf isomorphisms. The equation d.projection gives their scalar square. Apply normalized ordinaryScalarSquare to transport scalar extension along these ring isomorphisms, then transport the local recorded model to the chosen scalarReductionExtension by its object and map equations.

The inverse sheafification comparison fixes pure tensors. The ring-isomorphism comparison maps r tensor x to the tensor with the transformed coefficient; cancel the finite coefficient isomorphism. The object transports preserve these sheafified tensors, yielding the displayed formula.

theorem sf_clopen_scalar_module_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (T : Scheme.{t}) (U : T.Opens)
    (d : SfClopenCoefficientRestriction l E T U) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : scalarReductionExtension l E T n ⋙
        sfClopenModuleRestriction U _ _ (d.finite n) ≅
      sfClopenModuleRestriction U (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T)
        (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E U.toScheme) d.completion ⋙
        scalarReductionExtension l E U.toScheme n,
      ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E T) (V : U.toScheme.ProEt)
        (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E U.toScheme n).obj.obj (op V))
        (x : M.val.obj (op ((sfClopenSiteInclusion U).obj V))),
      ((c.hom.app M).val.app (op V))
        (unrestrictedTowerTensorSection l E T n M
          (op ((sfClopenSiteInclusion U).obj V)) ((d.finite n).hom.hom.app (op V) s) x) =
      unrestrictedTowerTensorSection l E U.toScheme n
        ((sfClopenModuleRestriction U _ _ d.completion).obj M) (op V) s x
